about: BATCH 14 ENTRY 26. The Review's Book prefix ends at the first move the engine grades Mistake, Blunder or Miss (chess.jsx bookSound), so a trap a lesson teaches is not theory. Graded by gate 186: part N (node) re-grades, with the shipped grader, every lesson line and every named-position line holding a case on the engine numbers in gates/fixtures/book-breaks.json (196 book plies, 8 allowing a forced mate) and holds each to its grade, the plies before it to Book and the 94 sound lesson lines to Book throughout; part B (a trial bundle at kunal761, 375x761 with ct_safe 51,31, and 320x568) reviews the Scholar's Mate game (3...Nf6 Blunder, not praised as an opening move, 4.Qxf7# not Book, the summary counts it and scores Black) and the Italian (Book on all six plies). Three ways the fix could come undone are each caught. NOT COVERED: the regrade preview's and the background tally's Best/Great split (regradeGame, analyzeGameCounts; the same cut applied as the plies are graded, no gate drives them here), a game reviewed at another depth than the fixture's 12, iOS Safari, his own look on the phone.
